steps.npc: Shut up Grubfoot!

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: But me not say anything!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Shut up Grubfoot!

steps.npc: Shut up Wartface!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Shut up Bentnoze!

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: Shut up generals!

steps.npc: Shut up Grubfoot!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Shut up Grubfoot!

steps.npc: What we do now Wartface?

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Me dunno... maybe we change armour colour again.

steps.npc: Human, what colour you think best?

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Yeah brown is nice.

steps.npc: Thanks human.
Our soldiers need better weapons. We give them all warhammers!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: No no give them battleaxes!

steps.npc: Axes stupid! They things you cut wood with!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: But hammers things you put nails in wood with! At least axes sharp!

steps.npc: You not need sharp when you have strong goblin swinging big lump of iron!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Shut up human, we sort this one out ourselves!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Me tell Mudknuckles make worm stew for dinner.

steps.npc: Me not like worm stew! Tell him make beetle pie!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Beetle pie give you wind! You smell bad enough already!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Now you've solved our argument, we gotta think of something else to do.

steps.npc: Yep, we bored now.
When Chosen Commander come to speak to us again?

steps.player: I don't know. I don't think she was making any progress when she spoke to you before.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: We listen to whatever she say!

steps.npc: Yeah, as long as she agree with truths of Big High War God!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Goblins mighty, war good, Big High War God greatest god!

steps.player: I don't think Zanik is likely to say any of that.

steps.npc: Then she not come here again!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Human! Did you save chosen commander from horrible fate?

steps.npc: That good. Big High War God smile on you now. You honourary goblin!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Last night I have vision of chosen commander. She say me biggest general, so me lead village.

steps.npc: You not have vision! You make that up!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: In my vision, chosen commander say you say that. So now I know it true.

steps.npc: Well... I have vision too. Chosen commander say me big general!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: That not fair! Me have vision first!

steps.npc: Chosen commander also say you fat and stupid.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Shut up!

treasure-trails-hard.text: Bentnoze has given you a puzzle box!

treasure-trails-hard-while-holding-the-p.text: If the puzzle box is not solved:

steps.npc: That not right!

treasure-trails-hard-while-holding-the-p.text: If the puzzle box is solved:

steps.npc: Thank you human!
